_note: How the fidelity gate ARRIVES at a screen. One entry per in-scope screen
id: which door, which route, and which login gets there. Extending the
gate to another journey is adding entries here — never editing the gate.
or 'console:<persona-key>' (the console's persona card, by data-persona).
route: the hash route inside the door, or '' for the door's entry screen.
A screen with no entry here is out of the gate's scope and is reported as
such — the gate never silently passes a screen it did not visit.

scope.why: Phase 1 is scoped to J3 — setting up a project (P-1 Org Admin, P-2 Project Configurator) — plus the five connective-tissue screens our own design adds (docs/design/j3-connective-tissue/README.md). The G-2 wave adds the org onboarding journey (g2_1..g2_13; g2_2/g2_3 do not exist in the reference): the onboarding door is deliberately reachable with no persona (#20, #155 phase D), so every g2 arrival is anon. Screens the ledger does not call implemented skip with the ledger's own gap note; their entries carry a note naming the missing backend capability so the map stays honest and flips naturally when the capability lands.
